blk_part_04_part_4_the_guerewol_meeting_.text: The Guérewol is a yearly courtship competition among the Wodaabe Fula people of Niger. Courtship means trying to attract someone as a possible partner. Young men wear rich decorations and traditional face painting. They stand in lines, dance, and sing to win the attention of young women. The dance is called the Yaake.

blk_part_05_part_5_the_monkey_buffet_fes.text: The Monkey Buffet Festival happens every year in Lopburi, Thailand, north of Bangkok. A buffet usually offers a range of food to choose from. Here, the food is for local crab-eating macaques, a kind of monkey. People give them fruit and vegetables, for example at the Phra Prang Sam Yod temple. Sometimes fruit is frozen inside blocks of ice.

blk_part_06_part_6_fire_walking_on_beqa_.text: Beqa is an island in Fiji, about 10 kilometres south of the main island, Viti Levu. Several of Beqa’s nine villages are known for fire-walking. In this practice, people walk across hot stones. In Fiji, it is practised by the Sawau clan, a community group on Beqa.
